cohort: The cohort consisted of 2144 Ecuadorian neonates who died within 28 days of birth, with a focus on those experiencing mortality before 24 hours.
finding: The study found that Apgar scores of <= 3 were significantly associated with a 20.65-fold increased odds of early neonatal mortality (before 24 hours).
mod_finding: The association between Apgar score and early neonatal mortality was independent of the type of delivery.
